description: This file defines the StreamNotReadableException class, which extends from the base Exception class within the ZipStream namespace. It is used to handle error conditions when a stream cannot be read, specifically when fread fails on a stream.

classes.name: StreamNotReadableException
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a stream cannot be read due to fread failure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message indicating the stream for the given filename could not be read.
